subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should the Control UI support arbitrary or legacy non-tab URL prefixes when gateway.controlUi.basePath is unset, or should support stay limited to root, known routes, /__openclaw__/, and configured basePath?
rationale: Current docs only promise root and configured basePath, while current tests intentionally keep arbitrary prefixed static assets at 404; changing that is a route-contract and static-file-boundary decision, not just a mechanical repair.

options.title: Limit to documented routes
options.body: Treat arbitrary prefix public-asset 404s as out of scope once the shipped root/configured-basePath fixes are confirmed, then close or narrow this issue accordingly.

options.title: Support arbitrary prefixes
options.body: Accept the broader deep-link behavior and request a narrow fix around Vite base/public asset inference/gateway asset routing with static-file safety tests.

options.title: Support only legacy aliases
options.body: Preserve specific old bookmarks such as /connections while rejecting general unknown prefixes to avoid widening the static asset surface.

recommendation.title: Limit to documented routes
recommendation.body: Treat arbitrary prefix public-asset 404s as out of scope once the shipped root/configured-basePath fixes are confirmed, then close or narrow this issue accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent current-main and gateway static-asset history in the affected path and are the best available routing candidate for the URL-contract decision.
